---
title: "Half-A aggregate screening: TWFE common-population sensitivity"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

Run after the existing aggregate computation and before the presentation pages. This additive step opens only the prepared A input, assignment metadata, county metadata and validated A-only saved-fit caches. Existing statistical CSVs and the decision file are read-only. New CSVs live in `_output/analysis/output/3.1a/twfe_common/`.

```{r}
root<-normalizePath(getwd())
while(!file.exists(file.path(root,'_quarto.yml'))) {
  parent<-dirname(root);if(parent==root)stop('Repository not found');root<-parent
}
source(file.path(root,'R/heldout_twfe_population.R'))
results<-run_twfe_common_population(root)
knitr::kable(results$twfe_common_summary[subgroup=='noncore' & diagnostic=='unscreened',
  .(scenario,model,rmse,relative_rmse,coverage,n_retained,mean_observed_aggregate)],digits=3)
```
